hypotheses.R0_thirty_two_point_paths_are_numericall: Maximum state and centered-logit relative errors are below 1e-4 and the all-path median Fisher fidelity is at least 0.9999 in every cell.
hypotheses.R1_top_path_fidelities_are_stable: Top-32, top-128, and top-256 median fidelities differ from the retained eight-point run by at most 0.03 everywhere.
hypotheses.R2_bilinear_projection_is_stable: The signed projection of paths containing a bilinear arm differs from the eight-point run by at most 0.03 everywhere.
hypotheses.R3_one_hundred_twenty_eight_paths_are_su: Top 128 reaches at least 0.95 fidelity in every selected held-out-template corruption cell.
hypotheses.R4_mean_rank_transfers_to_wrong_digit_su: Selected cyclic-substitution top-256 fidelity is at least 0.75 in every run.
hypotheses.R5_ranked_paths_beat_random_banks: Selected mean-erasure top-128 fidelity exceeds random-bank p95 by at least 0.10 in every run.
hypotheses.R6_path_program_transfers_templates: Selected top-256 mean-erasure fidelity differs by at most 0.10 between templates in every run.
hypotheses.R7_signal_gate_passes: Every finite-effect cell contains at least 64 effectful examples.
